look_here_first: First check size and leaves. This is a much taller rhizomatous perennial than the small local skullcaps, with large triangular-ovate leaves, truncate to shallowly heart-shaped bases, crenate margins, and relatively large blue-violet flowers.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: corollas much larger than S. drummondii, roughly 21–25 mm in regional comparison treatments

lookalikes.differences: S. drummondii is a small glandular-hairy annual with acute leaves and much smaller flowers; S. wrightii is a low bushy perennial with small rounded entire leaves. S. ovata is taller, rhizomatous, and conspicuously larger-leaved and larger-flowered.
